reviewFixes.proofPlacement: Every changed-input saved inspection successfully verifies current alternate proof. Confirmed resumption performs one pre-confirmation GraphQL lookup; changed head/replacement identity then refuse at result reconciliation (the replacement cannot re-associate the saved original PR) without another lookup, while the remote-lease case performs a second per-merge proof lookup before refusing.
reviewFixes.preservation: Separate head, replacement PR number/URL and bare remote lease changes preserve last confirmed base merge, successor work, pending PR and remote state, opaque local/index/cache/recovery snapshots (except owned lock refresh), and cause no later merge/push/PR-edit effect.

artifactReuse.reason: No production source or packaged production input changed from historical accepted build; native and tarball SHA256 identities rechecked. Artifacts were not rebuilt or relabelled as review-fix commit builds.

exploratoryReports.classification: Superseded assertion-only failures: first expected readiness-stage diagnostics despite earlier result reconciliation, then expected no resumed GraphQL calls despite the successful pre-confirmation inspection; finally expected fresh replacement identity diagnostic despite cached original PR lookup refusing earlier. Production guards unchanged.
